# SilvoTech

SilvoTech is a B2B manufacturer and distributor of silicone hoses in Europe.

Primary pages:
- https://www.silvotech.eu/pl
- https://www.silvotech.eu/en
- https://www.silvotech.eu/de

Core products:
- Transparent silicone hose suitable for food-contact applications, available in 20 m coils and 28 standard sizes.
- Black silicone hose for technical industrial applications.

Key technical information:
- Operating range: -50 °C to +230 °C.
- Standard packaging: 20 m coils.
- Custom dimensions available on request.
- Documentation for the tested transparent product is available on request, including declaration of conformity and German laboratory test results for Regulation (EC) No 1935/2004 and LFGB scope.
